lines.1: Another day of chaos came to an end with the sunset.
lines.2: 「Jeez. Why am I the one doing this?」
lines.3: Sato had something to take care of, so I was cleaning up the Dragon Palace in her place.
lines.4: Well, I guess I had to do this sort of thing once in a while.
lines.5: All right. Everything was locked up.
lines.6: Now I had to return the key to Miss Inori.
lines.8: 「Yeah, pretty much. I just need to drop off this key.」
lines.9: 「I going faculty room anyway. I return it for you.」
